title: TEL: dividend sustainability and valuation discipline

price.kind: Last traded snapshot, not a closing price

assumptions.discount_rate_basis: Chosen nominal PHP equity-return hurdle, not a measured CAPM estimate or WACC. Stress tested from 10% to 14% given leverage and dividend risk.
assumptions.growth_basis: Conservative 1% perpetual dividend growth scenario given low service-revenue growth and a lower latest interim dividend. Not company guidance.
assumptions.dividend_basis: Last twelve months of common dividends paid: 46 in April 2026 plus 46 in September 2026. Future maintenance is an assumption, not a declared full-year 2026 payout.

scope: Dated public-source research illustration. Discrete cited facts and original calculations only; no copied reports. No exhaustive disclosure review or verified CAPM estimate. Reassess before using as an investment view.
